label: PF Backlog 200
title: Backend: media QA validators (probe / loudness / perceptual-hash / A-V sync)
body:
## Problem / why
Text compliance exists; media outputs have no quality gate.

## Goal
Media validators run at validate (11/12): ffprobe (codec/res/fps/duration), loudness (EBU R128),
perceptual-hash continuity (no broken frames), A/V sync, format/size limits.

## Acceptance criteria
- A generated/edited media artifact is validated; failures surface as compliance findings.

## Verification / test plan
- Feed a bad/corrupt media file -> validator fails; good file -> passes.

dashboard_impact.reason: Backend capability; consumed via API, no UI change.
